changeSet.comment: Fix #2935. 20261009001 remapped stored dashboard/visualization fields with compact-JSON literals ("field":"log.X"); rows serialized with a space after the colon ("field": "log.X") matched the WHERE guard but REPLACE changed nothing, leaving ~24 compliance LIST_CHART columns on dead log.* fields. 20261012001 later covered the spaced form for aggregation only. This re-applies the SAME final mapping to the spaced form: filters/query/dashboard.filters -> 001 target; aggregation -> 012(001 target) so spaced rows land exactly where compact rows already are. Idempotent (LIKE-guarded, matches nothing once remapped).
